posts.title: Elementor Speed Checklist (Quick Wins)
posts.excerpt: A practical list to make Elementor sites feel faster without rewriting the whole theme.
posts.author: Abhishek Thakur
posts.content:
Most Elementor sites feel slow because of heavy sections, unoptimized images, and too many widgets.

Start with images: export WebP, set correct size, and lazy-load below the fold.

Then audit widgets — remove unused ones, limit animations, and avoid stacking multiple nested containers.

Finally, use a lightweight theme, caching, and only the plugins you truly need.

posts.title: What to Ask Before Building a Client Site
posts.excerpt: A simple brief that saves revisions and keeps projects on schedule.
posts.author: Abhishek Thakur
posts.content:
Before design starts, lock goals, audience, must-have pages, and brand assets.

Ask for examples they like (and dislike), form fields they need, and who approves the final site.

Define mobile priority, SEO basics, and launch checklist early.

posts.title: GoHighLevel Landing Page Structure That Converts
posts.excerpt: A clean section order for funnels: hook, proof, offer, objections, CTA.
posts.author: Abhishek Thakur
posts.content:
Open with one clear promise and a single primary action.

Follow with benefits, social proof, and a short FAQ that removes fear.

Keep the mobile CTA sticky and the form short.
